basics.name: Harsh Nigam
basics.label: Marketing Strategist · SEO, AI Search, Paid Ads & Social Media
basics.summary: Marketing Strategist at IInfotanks, an AI-powered agency, leading a 21-person team across content, design, development, QC and off-page SEO. Looks after SEO, AI search (AEO/GEO), Google and Meta Ads, and social media for 10+ clients in India and the US: 5-10% traffic growth every month, 10-15% more leads every quarter, and around 2.5:1 ROAS on paid campaigns.

work.name: IInfotanks
highlights: Lead a 21-person team of writers, designers, developers, QC and off-page specialists across 10+ retained clients in SaaS, staffing, real estate, manufacturing and more, in India and the US.
Run search end to end for every account (on-page, off-page, technical SEO and AI search visibility), with the team turning over 300+ webpages a month.
Consistently meet monthly KPIs: traffic up 5-10% a month for every client and leads up 10-15% a quarter.
Manage Google Ads and Meta Ads end to end, averaging 2.5:1 ROAS while steadily bringing CPCs down.
Plan and run social for clients and the agency, from content calendars and LinkedIn thought leadership to paid social on Meta.
Built reporting that tracks how client brands are mentioned and described in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Copilot.
Built the production system: trackers and dashboards that move every page from content to design, development, publishing and QC on time.
Turn live-crawl SEO and AI visibility audits into tiered retainer proposals: 60+ produced for prospects in India, the US and beyond.

work.name: IInfotanks
highlights: Shaped content strategy and editorial calendars across blogs, social, email and websites, tying each piece to lead generation and brand goals.
Managed creation, editing and publishing with a consistent brand voice, including executive LinkedIn posts and video scripts.
Ran email campaigns with A/B testing and segmentation, and grew social channels using trend tracking and analytics.
